title: Slots Basics
intro: Pick a bet, then spin. Every machine pays exact, published odds from your chips.

steps.say: Press spin to pull the reels. Click spin and watch the payout line.
steps.tip: Spin is always the big button. The stake comes from your wallet.
steps.praise: That is a spin. Matches on a line pay; three jackpot symbols pay the most.

steps.say: Choose what a spin is worth: click bet50 to set a bigger stake.
steps.tip: The bet ladder runs from 25 up. Pick a stake you can keep paying.
steps.praise: Stake set. The cost of a spin is taken from your chips each time.

steps.say: Now spin at your new stake. Click spin and the reels turn again.
steps.tip: Every spin costs the stake, so watch your chips as well as the reels.
steps.praise: You have the machine. Change machines above the reels any time.
